description:
You have a simple desk lamp model made of 4 mesh parts: LampBase, LampLowerArm, LampUpperArm, and LampHead. Your task is to create a bone armature (skeleton) so the lamp can be posed and animated.

1. Create a new Armature object at or near the lamp base.
2. In Edit Mode on the Armature, add exactly 4 bones named: 'Base', 'LowerArm', 'UpperArm', 'Head'.
3. Set up the bone parent chain: Base (root) -> LowerArm -> UpperArm -> Head. That is, LowerArm's parent is Base, UpperArm's parent is LowerArm, and Head's parent is UpperArm.
4. Position the bones so they roughly follow the lamp structure from bottom to top.
5. Parent all 4 lamp mesh objects (LampBase, LampLowerArm, LampUpperArm, LampHead) to the Armature using Armature Deform or Object parenting.
6. Save the project to '/home/ga/BlenderProjects/lamp_rigged.blend'.
